{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint lacks a stated analysis method",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is defined but no statistical analysis method (e.g., exact binomial confidence interval, hypothesis test) is described in the statistical methods section for this endpoint.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed analysis description for the primary endpoint ORR, including the estimation method, confidence interval, and hypothesis testing if applicable."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary safety endpoint has no analysis description",
      "quote": "AEs, serious adverse events (SAEs), and AEs leading to discontinuation or death, and severity of AEs as assessed by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoint is listed but the statistical methods section only mentions safety assessments in general terms without specifying how AEs will be summarized or analyzed.",
      "fix": "Provide a detailed safety analysis plan, including AE incidence rates, severity grading, and handling of treatment-emergent AEs."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: the population is implied (ITT) but not explicitly stated, the variable is defined, but intercurrent events (e.g., death, discontinuation, missing response) and the summary measure (proportion) are not fully specified in the endpoint definition.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes explicitly, including the handling of intercurrent events (e.g., treatment discontinuation, death) and the summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size section is incomplete and inconsistent",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 80% power to detect a difference of 13% using",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The sample size statement is cut off and does not specify the statistical test, the null hypothesis, the expected response rate, or the significance level. This is a critical gap for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Complete the sample size justification, including the test (e.g., exact binomial), the null and alternative response rates, alpha, and power."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no corresponding analysis is described in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis section describing how blood concentrations will be summarized and analyzed (e.g., non-compartmental analysis, descriptive statistics)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis method is provided in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an immunogenicity analysis section describing how anti-Qb antibody data will be summarized and analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory biomarker endpoints",
      "quote": "Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers related to TLR9, immune checkpoints, and potential markers of resistance or response to immunotherapy",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory biomarker endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis is described for them in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an exploratory biomarker analysis section describing how baseline and change from baseline will be summarized and analyzed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory CXCL10 endpoint",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The CXCL10/cytokine endpoint is listed but no analysis method is provided in the statistical methods section.",
      "fix": "Add an analysis section for cytokine endpoints, including how change from baseline will be summarized and tested."
    }
  ]
}
